36034-white-nights-and-other-stories.title: White Nights And Other Stories
36034-white-nights-and-other-stories.creator: Unknown
36034-white-nights-and-other-stories.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. e embankment, there was not one face of those I had been accustomed to meet at the same time and place all the year. They, of course, do not know me, but I know them. I know them intimately, I have almost made a study of their faces, and am delighted when they are gay, and downcast when they are under a cloud.

38464-tempting-curry-dishes.creator: Thomas J. Murrey,
38464-tempting-curry-dishes.description: A book by Thomas J. Murrey,. a combination of various fruits, spices, condiments, roots, seeds, etc., which were either pounded together dry or worked to a paste and dried afterwards. There were hundreds of these preparations which were used in different dishes; each dish had its own separate powder. They are known to modern civilization as Curry powders.

5056-plays-second-series.title: Plays Second Series
5056-plays-second-series.creator: John Galsworthy
5056-plays-second-series.description: A book by John Galsworthy. in the black dress of a lady's-maid, is standing at the foot of the staircase with a bunch of white roses in one hand, and a bunch of yellow roses in the other. A door closes above, and SIR WILLIAM CHESHIRE, in evening dress, comes downstairs. He is perhaps fifty-eight, of strong build, rather bull-necked, with grey eyes, and a well-coloured face, whose choleric autocracy is veiled by a thin urbanity. He speaks before he reaches the bottom.

arxiv-2106-06868.title: Short-term forecasting of global solar irradiance with incomplete data
arxiv-2106-06868.creator: Laura S. Hoyos-Gómez, Jose F. Ruiz-Muñoz, Belizza J. Ruiz-Mendoza
arxiv-2106-06868.description: Abstract Accurate mechanisms for forecasting solar irradiance and insolation provide important information for the planning of renewable energy and agriculture projects as well as for environmental and socio-economical studies. This research introduces a pipeline for the one-day ahead forecasting of solar irradiance and insolation that only requires solar irradiance historical data for training.

arxiv-2110-13993.title: Planetary Nebulae: Sources of Enlightenment
arxiv-2110-13993.creator: Karen B. Kwitter, R.B.C. Henry
arxiv-2110-13993.description: Abstract In this review/tutorial we explore planetary nebulae as a stage in the evolution of low-to-intermediate-mass stars, as major contributors to the mass and chemical enrichment of the interstellar medium, and as astrophysical laboratories. We discuss many observed properties of planetary nebulae, placing particular emphasis on element abundance determinations and comparisons with theoretical predictions.

arxiv-2203-12070.title: A Friedlander type estimate for Stokes operators
arxiv-2203-12070.creator: C. Denis and A.F.M. ter Elst
arxiv-2203-12070.description: Abstract Abstract . Let \Omega\subset\mathds{R}^{d} be a bounded open connected set with Lipschitz boundary. Let A^{N} and A^{D} be the Neumann Stokes operator and Dirichlet Stokes operator on \Omega , respectively. Further let \lambda_{1}^{N}\leq\lambda_{2}^{N}\leq\ldots and \lambda_{1}^{D}\leq\lambda_{2}^{D}\leq\ldots be the eigenvalues of A^{N} and A^{D} repeated with multiplicity, respectively. Then \lambda_{n+1}^{N}<\lambda_{n}^{D} for all n\in\mathds{N} . † † footnotetext: Mathematics Subject Classification .

arxiv-2304-09447.title: A relative Toponogov comparison theorem Thanks: The author is supported by Natural Science Foundation of Shaanxi Province of China (No.2022JM-010) and Shaanxi Fundamental Science Research Project for Mathematics and Physics (No.22JSY025)
arxiv-2304-09447.creator: Jianming Wan
arxiv-2304-09447.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jianming Wan. We present a relative form of the Toponogov comparison theorem. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 53C20,53C23 1. Main result Let M be a complete Riemannian manifold with sectional curvature sec_{M}\geq k,(k=0,-1,1) and S^{n}_{k} the simply connected spaces form. Let \gamma_{1},\gamma_{2} be two geodesic segments in M such that \gamma_{1}(0)=\gamma_{2}(0) and \bar{\gamma}_{1},\bar{\gamma}_{2} be two geodesic segments in S^{n}_{k} such that \bar{\gamma}_{1}(0)=\bar{\gamma}_{2}(0) . \measuredangle(\gamma_{1}^{{}^{\prime}}(0),\gamma_{2}^{{}^{\prime}}(0))=\measuredangle(\bar{\gamma}_{1}^{{}^{\prime}}(0),\bar{\gamma}_{2}^{{}^{\prime}}(0))=\alpha . Let r(t)=d_{M}(\gamma_{1}(b),\gamma_{2}(t)) and \bar{r}(t)=d_{S^{n}_{k}}(\bar{\gamma}_{1}(b),\bar{\gamma}_{2}(t)) . Toponogov comparison theorem [ 4 ] claims that r(t)\leq\bar{r}(t).

arxiv-2311-16935.title: A fast, matrix-based method to perform omnidirectional pressure integration
arxiv-2311-16935.creator: Fernando Zigunov & John J. Charonko
arxiv-2311-16935.description: Abstract Experimentally-measured pressure fields play an important role in understanding many fluid dynamics problems. Unfortunately, pressure fields are difficult to measure directly with non-invasive, spatially resolved diagnostics, and calculations of pressure from velocity have proven sensitive to error in the data.

arxiv-2502-17541.title: Dataset Featurization: Uncovering Natural Language Features through Unsupervised Data Reconstruction
arxiv-2502-17541.creator: Michal Bravansky, Vaclav Kubon, Suhas Hariharan, Robert Kirk
arxiv-2502-17541.description: Abstract Interpreting data is central to modern research. Large language models (LLMs) show promise in providing such natural language interpretations of data, yet simple feature extraction methods such as prompting often fail to produce accurate and versatile descriptions for diverse datasets and lack control over granularity and scale.

arxiv-2504-06439.title: Graph Neural Network-Based Distributed Optimal Control for Linear Networked Systems: An Online Distributed Training Approach
arxiv-2504-06439.creator: Zihao Song, Shirantha Welikala, Panos J. Antsaklis, Hai Lin
arxiv-2504-06439.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the distributed optimal control problem for linear networked systems. In particular, we are interested in learning distributed optimal controllers using graph recurrent neural networks (GRNNs). Most of the existing approaches result in centralized optimal controllers with offline training processes.

arxiv-2505-22623.title: A theory for diffusion-controlled reactions within nonequilibrium steady states
arxiv-2505-22623.creator: Seokjin Moon, David T. Limmer
arxiv-2505-22623.description: Abstract We study diffusion-controlled processes in nonequilibrium steady states, where standard rate theory assumptions break down. Using transition path theory, we generalize the relations between reactive probability fluxes and measures of the rate of the reaction. Stochastic thermodynamics analysis reveals how work constrains the enhancement of rates relative to their equilibrium values.

arxiv-2508-06066.title: Architecture-Aware Generalization Bounds for Temporal Networks: Theory and Fair Comparison Methodology
arxiv-2508-06066.creator: Barak Gahtan, Alex M. Bronstein
arxiv-2508-06066.description: Abstract Deep temporal architectures such as Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCNs) achieve strong predictive performance on sequential data, yet theoretical understanding of their generalization remains limited. We address this gap by providing both the first non-vacuous, architecture-aware generalization bounds for deep temporal models and a principled evaluation methodology.

arxiv-2509-05897.title: q q -analogues of π \pi -formulas due to Ramanujan and Guillera
arxiv-2509-05897.description: Abstract The first known q q -analogues for any of the 17 17 formulas for 1 π \frac{1}{\pi} due to Ramanujan were introduced in 2018 by Guo and Liu (J. Difference Equ. Appl. 29:505–513, 2018), via the q q -Wilf–Zeilberger method.

arxiv-2601-16797.title: Ultrafast Dipolar Electrostatic Modeling of Plasmonic Nanoparticles with Arbitrary Geometry
arxiv-2601-16797.creator: Paulo S. S. dos Santos ID, João P. Mendes ID, José M. M. M. de Almeida ID, Luís C. C. Coelho ID
arxiv-2601-16797.description: Abstract Accurate and fast calculations of localized surface plasmon resonances (LSPR) in metallic nanoparticles is essential for applications in sensing, nano-optics, and energy harvesting. Although full-wave numerical techniques such as the boundary element method (BEM) or the discrete dipole approximation (DDA) provide high accuracy, their computational cost often hinders rapid parametric studies.

Mobility data represent an important proxy measure of social...

pmc-11520524.title: Nephroprotective role of resveratrol in renal ischemia-reperfusion injury: a preclinical study in Sprague-Dawley rats
pmc-11520524.creator: Elaf R Alaasam, Ali M Janabi, Karrar M Al-Buthabhak, Rihab H Almudhafar, Najah R Hadi, Athanasios Alexiou, Marios Papadakis, Mohammed E Abo-El Fetoh, Dalia Fouad, Gaber El-Saber Batiha
pmc-11520524.description: BackgroundRenal ischemia-reperfusion injury (IRI) is a significant contributor to renal dysfunction, acute kidney injury (AKI), and associated morbidity and mortality. Resveratrol, a polyphenol and phytoalexin, is known for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. This study investigates the nephroprotective potential of resveratrol in a rat model of renal IRI.

pmc-11619569.title: Exploring heterogeneity of perimenopause with application of multivariable analysis approaches
pmc-11619569.creator: Zhongyu Huang, Huazhi You, Lijuan Li, Shuang Wang, Zipan Lyu, Xiaoqin Zeng, Changyan Zhu, Minqing Li, Han Yan, Yaojuan He
pmc-11619569.description: ObjectivesHeterogeneity of clinical appearance had made it a challenge to make individualized and comprehensive management of perimenopause. This study aimed to estimate the profiles over heterogenous appearances of perimenopause with application of latent variable analysis methods over an optimized multidimensional assessing framework.MethodsA two-phase clinical study was designed and advanced in the research center in Guangzhou, China.

pmc-12466553.title: Cold Plasma as a Revolutionary Antimicrobial Modality: A Multifaceted Weapon Against Antibiotic Resistance
pmc-12466553.creator: Yehia A.-G. Mahmoud, Nehal E. Elkaliny, Farah M. Elshikh, Yara Ashraf, Kamel Metwally, Galal Yahya, Sameha Sherif
pmc-12466553.description: The rise of antibiotic resistance has transformed once-curable infections into urgent global health threats, leaving hospitals with outbreaks, patients with prolonged illnesses, and doctors with limited therapeutic options. The era of antibiotic resistance is no longer a distant concern; it is a pressing reality demanding innovative solutions.

pmc-12595400.title: Real‐time CO2 monitoring for early detection of grain spoilage and mycotoxin contamination
pmc-12595400.creator: Elisavet Kiaitsi, Sandro Zanardi, Michael Sulyok, Angel Medina, Ben Ingram, Michele Suman, Esther Garcia‐Cela
pmc-12595400.description: BACKGROUNDThis study aimed to compare the use of real‐time CO2 , temperature (T) and relative humidity (RH) sensors as indicators of stored grain quality management, specifically for early detection of mould activity and mycotoxin contamination. Initial experiments were conducted using mini‐silos containing naturally contaminated wheat grain (1.

pmc-13249092.title: Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumor in Lynch Syndrome: Expanding the Tumor Spectrum of Mismatch Repair Deficiency
pmc-13249092.creator: Sai Sushrutha Mudupula Vemula, Soumith Sanka, Varun Natarajan, Merryl T Varghese, Daniel Isaac
pmc-13249092.description: Lynch syndrome is an autosomal dominant hereditary cancer syndrome caused by germline mutations in DNA mismatch repair genes. Currently, Lynch syndrome has well-established associations with colorectal and endometrial cancers. However, a definitive association between Lynch syndrome and pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (P-NETs) remains unestablished.

pmc-13382458.title: Prevalence, resistance profile, and molecular epidemiology of extended-spectrum β-lactamases producing Escherichia coli from captive giant pandas
pmc-13382458.creator: Xia Yan, Lucai Wang, Huanrong Zhang, Mei Yang, Bingyu Xue, Ruoshui Zhao, Lin Li, Junjin Xie, Songrui Liu, Xueyang Fan, Xiaoyan Su
pmc-13382458.description: Background/objectiveExtended-spectrum β-lactamase (ESBL)-producing Escherichia coli (E. coli), a bacterium resistant to most β-lactam antibiotics, is a critical clinical global health concern, posing significant health risks to humans and animals including giant pandas. The Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding (CRBGP) has the world's largest captive population of giant pandas.

pmc-13406514.title: A Label-Free Cell-Based Biosensor Method for Ethanol Quantification Using Temperature-Induced Spontaneous Cell Detachment
pmc-13406514.creator: Derick Yongabi, Alex Krane, Heloisa Espreafico Guelerman Ramos, Sofia Xavier Bustia, Jonas Gruber, Michael J. Schöning, Frank Delvigne, Patrick Wagner
pmc-13406514.description: Rapid, low-cost ethanol quantification is vital for beverage quality control, biofuel production, and pharmaceutical applications, yet current approaches are costly, reagent- or label-dependent, or rely on spectroscopy with substantial sample preparation. We introduce a purely cell-based, label-free biosensor that exploits temperature-gradient-induced spontaneous detachment of Saccharomyces cerevisiae from a chip surface.

pmc-13520399.title: Risk prediction of echinococcosis in China under climate change: a One Health approach
pmc-13520399.creator: Tengyue Diao, Nan Xu, Ning Ma, Haiyan Chen, Na Wang, Ting La, Kunyi Wu, Bo Cao

pmc-13559863.title: Synthesis and Antifungal Evaluation of Isoquinoline‐3‐amide Derivatives Containing a Phenoxypyridine Moiety for Plant Protection
pmc-13559863.creator: Jiayao Zhang, Shuaipeng Sun, Yajing Guo, Zhiyuan Xu, Jing Zhang, Gang Feng, Haixin Ding, Qiang Xiao
pmc-13559863.description: To discover novel green antifungal candidates, 20 3‐acylaminoisoquinoline derivatives were designed and synthesized by introducing the active fragment phenoxypyridine. Their structures were verified by 1H NMR, 13C NMR, and HRMS. The structure of compound X9 was further confirmed via X‐ray crystallography. Their antifungal activities against five phytopathogenic fungi were evaluated to develop isoquinoline‐based antifungal agents.

uslaw-usc-t10-s127c.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part I (Organization And General Military Powers); Chapter 3 (General Powers And Functions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Authority.— When elements of the armed forces are engaged in ongoing military operations in a country, the Secretary of Defense may, for the purpose of protecting United States forces in that country, purchase weapons from any.

uslaw-usc-t2-s5302.title: 2 U.S.C. § 5302 — Salaries payable monthly after taking oath
uslaw-usc-t2-s5302.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t2-s5302.description: United States Code, Title 2 (The Congress); Chapter 53 (House Of Representatives Members); Subchapter I (Member Pay). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Each Member and Delegate, after he has taken and subscribed the required oath, is entitled to receive his salary at the end of each month.
